subject.title: Preserve aborted sessions across restart opt-in

question: Should OpenClaw accept `session.restartContinuation` as the opt-in contract for preserving aborted main-session ids across controlled Gateway restarts?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but the change adds a compatibility-sensitive session config surface and chooses product semantics for restart/session recovery without maintainer sponsorship.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close this PR now and leave the linked issue open for a maintainer-sponsored config contract or alternate design.

options.title: Sponsor The Opt-In
options.body: Keep or reopen this PR if maintainers explicitly want `session.restartContinuation` as the supported narrow recovery knob.

options.title: Redirect To Config-Free Recovery
options.body: Ask for a replacement design that uses existing restart recovery mechanisms instead of adding a new session config option.

recommendation.title: Close Until Sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR now and leave the linked issue open for a maintainer-sponsored config contract or alternate design.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the merged terminal transcript reconciliation invariant that this PR changes and are a strong routing candidate for the session-state decision.
